## About
Abt Paint & Body is a small auto body shop in Orlando. We repair cars after accidents, and we take care of smaller things like a scratched bumper too.
Customers have found us through a friend, a car dealer, and even the company that damaged their vehicle. We'd like to keep earning that kind of word of mouth, one repair at a time. Our customers have rated us 4.8 from 30 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Accident repair: Repairs after an accident, done so the damage is hard to spot.
- Body work: Body work on your car, including work done through an insurance claim.
- Bumper scratches: Fixing scratches so your bumper looks good again.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do body work from an insurance claim?
A: One customer had body work done through an insurance claim with us. Give us a call and tell us about yours.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: On Saturday we're open from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Q: How can I reach you?
A: Call us at 407-800-9258 or email ng@abtpaintbodyshop.com.
